intro.markdown:
Two releases cut yesterday — `links-issue-tracker` v0.24.0 and `vhid` 0.6.0 — and today everything downstream turned into cleanup. Forty-three commits across four repos, most of them one-liners against clocks, locks, and watch keys. The ticket prefixes read `brandon-unfiled` and `links-unfiled` because none of it belongs to an epic. It's the sweeping that follows a release.

The one I keep coming back to: in `cc-candybar` the daemon's config watcher was keying its watches on inodes, so a symlinked `settings.json` rewritten by its editor silently stopped updating. The fix is to watch where the write lands, not what the file was yesterday. Not glamorous. One of the harder things to do consistently.

Over in `cc-hands`, the brain's end-to-end tests started running against `mock-anthropic` pinned at v0.1.0 — the Go rewrite from yesterday. Fast fixture to a thing that was a rewrite twelve hours ago. That part doesn't feel like a weekday.

projects.html: ### [orange-drink](https://github.com/promptctl/orange-drink) **Swift** A macOS menu-bar app and widgets for iPhone, iPad and Mac battery, with a privileged helper for charging controls. 210 commits over the past month, 20 this week. iPhone and iPad battery read over cable through usbmux and lockdown, and keep reading over Wi-Fi after one cable session ([#3](https://github.com/promptctl/orange-drink/pull/3), [#4](https://github.com/promptctl/orange-drink/pull/4), [#5](https://github.com/promptctl/orange-drink/pull/5)); a Mac Battery widget shipped signed as Developer ID ([#11](https://github.com/promptctl/orange-drink/pull/11)); a signed and notarized DMG builds from one script ([#7](https://github.com/promptctl/orange-drink/pull/7)). An admin-helper epic landed — a privileged helper over authenticated XPC accepts only its own app ([#13](https://github.com/promptctl/orange-drink/pull/13), [#15](https://github.com/promptctl/orange-drink/pull/15)), Low Power Mode toggles from the panel and the L-key ([#16](https://github.com/promptctl/orange-drink/pull/16)), and a Charge Limit UI holds charge at a target through the SMC ([#18](https://github.com/promptctl/orange-drink/pull/18), [#19](https://github.com/promptctl/orange-drink/pull/19), [#21](https://github.com/promptctl/orange-drink/pull/21)). The input method defaults to the main actor, IMK's callbacks hop through one logged entry, SE-0466 compiles on macos-26, main-actor inserts measured at 3.0 s with 11,162 reactivations lossless ([#213](https://github.com/promptctl/low-talker/pull/213), [#222](https://github.com/promptctl/low-talker/pull/222), [#223](https://github.com/promptctl/low-talker/pull/223), [#232](https://github.com/promptctl/low-talker/pull/232), [#233](https://github.com/promptctl/low-talker/pull/233)). The warnings epic — failed command events say why, hands file-tickets files one ticket per cause, a hung daemon run ends itself ([#332](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-hands/pull/332)–[#338](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-hands/pull/338), [#347](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-hands/pull/347)).
